title: sdk(ts): add Shadow Experiments types + client methods (pagination, filters)
author: Monica Patel
description: Adds first-class TypeScript SDK support for Shadow Experiments (Shadow Traffic quality metrics) including request/response types, client methods for CRUD + querying results, and cursor-based pagination + server-side filtering helpers. This is the TS companion to the Console backend endpoints landing in the monorepo and is intended for internal dogfood + Dedicated beta customers. API design notes: (1) We expose a thin wrapper over the Console API contract to avoid SDK-specific semantics; (2) pagination is cursor-based with `pageSize` + `cursor` to match backend and prevent offset-based drift; (3) filters are represented as a typed `ShadowExperimentResultFilter` with conservative enums to keep parity with backend validation; (4) we include `AbortSignal` and request id propagation via `x-redwood-request-id` for troubleshooting. Out of scope: SDK support for uploading custom rubrics or running eval-harness jobs directly (v1 remains Redwood-managed scoring). Manual test: against staging console-api with feature flag enabled; created experiment, verified list/query aggregates, fetched examples with pagination, and validated filter combinations. Checklist: - [x] Types added for experiments, variants, runs, aggregates, examples - [x] Client methods added with docs + JSDoc examples - [x] Pagination helpers + iterator utility for examples - [x] Unit tests for serialization, pagination, and filter encoding - [x] Changelog entry behind beta note - [x] Verified no breaking changes to existing SDK surfaces.

conversation: Chloe Martin (review): Can we align naming with console-api? Backend uses `cursor` and `page_size` query param; SDK should keep `cursor` but prefer `pageSize` on the TS side. Also please ensure we don’t leak internal rubric payloads in example types.

Monica Patel (author): Updated: TS surface is `pageSize`/`cursor`, encoded to `page_size`/`cursor` on the wire. Also removed `rubricPrompt` fields from `ShadowExample` type; now we only expose rubric version + metric outputs + artifact refs.

Dylan Brooks (review): +1 overall. Two nits: (1) `ShadowExperimentState` should include `paused` (Console uses it for kill-switch). (2) Can we add a small helper to page through examples since that’s the common workflow for debugging regressions?
Monica Patel (author): Added `paused` state + `iterateExamples()` async generator with backpressure-friendly paging. Also added docs comment warning about cost/retention when pulling many examples.

Jada Williams (review): Filter encoding: backend rejects unknown `segment` values; please restrict to enum and avoid raw string passthrough. Also ensure default filter omits empty params (we had a bug where `segment=` caused 400).
Monica Patel (author): Done. `segment` is now a string union, query builder omits undefined/empty values; added test coverage for empty filter objects.
Elliot Price (review): README snippet should mention the feature is beta + requires backend enablement/flag. Also add note that quality scoring is async and aggregates may lag.
Monica Patel (author): Added a short beta callout + scoring lag note in README + changelog entry.
Dylan Brooks (final): Approved. Please squash and include the changelog entry in the final commit message.
release_notes: TypeScript SDK: add beta Shadow Experiments client + types with cursor pagination and result filtering.
